info.name: Krishi Bhandar API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Krishi Bhandar e-commerce backend API.

Includes endpoints for Products, Categories, Collections, Cart, Orders & Payments (Razorpay), Customers, Coupons, Banners, Reviews, Media Upload, and Admin Dashboard.

variable.description: Base URL of the backend API server
JWT Bearer token for customer authentication
